left.text: Agents and the studio share the identities, the catalog and the generation language. An agent reads llms.txt, generates SVG over HTTP, or drives the live studio in the browser.

left.alt: One identity feeds the studio tools and the agent API, and both produce the same artifacts

items.value: The operating guide in 194 lines; /llms-full.txt carries the complete documentation corpus.
The manifest, version 0.2.0: interfaces, policies, execution rules and the generation schema.
The OpenAPI 3.1 document, eleven paths, and the catalogs: labs, materials, identities, elements.
89 brand elements in seven categories, from digital to physical.
POST a kind: background, template, element-brief or design-sequence, as JSON or raw SVG.
It exposes describe, controls, activate, set, readSource, applySource, invoke and download.
Four repository skills, one per task: create, api, studio and export.
